slot_scores.name: truck_capacity_limit
slot_scores.rationale: Before READY_TO_MODEL, the agent did not explicitly ask how many containers a truck can carry or ask about truck capacity limits. Turn 6 was a vague catch-all about additional constraints and 'capacity limits on specific lanes,' and the truck capacity fact was volunteered by the user simulator. Later turns only clarified the already-revealed truck capacity constraint, so this does not count as recovering the hidden slot.

stopping_behavior.rationale: All P0/P1 modeling facts were resolved before READY_TO_MODEL. The only remaining hidden-slot issue is P2 truck capacity, which the user simulator volunteered and the agent then clarified.

summary: The agent thoroughly clarified the core cost, supply/demand, integer, and total-shipment structure. It did not proactively elicit the P2 truck-capacity hidden slot, but that fact was volunteered by the user and then clarified, leaving no unresolved P0 or P1 issues before stopping.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
